title: Skill
description: Front-matter metadata for a skill directory (skills/<name>/SKILL.md). Only `name` and `description` are resident before activation — roughly 30-50 tokens — so the description is the entire trigger. The procedure body loads on activation; bundled references load only when the procedure reaches them.

name.description: Directory name. One skill, one procedure — a skill covering three loosely related things triggers on all three and helps with none.

description.description: MUST state WHEN to use this, not just what it is. 'Expand/contract database migrations' never fires; 'Use when a change alters a database schema — adding, removing, or changing columns, tables, or indexes' fires reliably.

roles.description: Agent roles whose context packs carry this skill's description. Scoping by role is the first defence against a bloated capability surface.

tier2_tokens.description: Approximate size of SKILL.md itself, paid on every activation. Above roughly a page, move detail into references.

references.description: Tier-3 files loaded on demand: engine-specific detail, worked examples, long tables.

requires_tools.description: Tools the procedure invokes. A skill whose tools the acting role lacks must not be offered to it.

failure_modes.description: What usually goes wrong. A procedure that states its failure modes outperforms one that only lists happy-path steps.

provenance.description: Skills are earned, not assumed — most originate as a pattern the Supervisor extracted from repeated escalations or Commission rejected_patterns.

eval.description: Promotion gate. A skill that does not measurably improve the golden task set does not ship — this is what stops the registry degenerating into contradictory folklore.

status.description: Retired when it stops improving the golden set — context budget is finite and every resident description is rent.
